fact: The policy working group at the Africa BB Maps national event (ITU/EU project, hosted with ZICTA, Lusaka, 9-11 December 2025) concluded that Zambia lacks a national broadband policy and recommended formulating one.

The Ministry of Technology and Science's National Digital Transformation Strategy 2023-2027 sets broadband targets, including national broadband coverage of 80 percent and average broadband speed from 2.73 to 5.00 mbps, and lists development of a national broadband master plan; the document gives no adoption date, so the start of its period, 2023, is used.
